interventions.detail: Python 3.6 unavailable via uv; created Python 3.7 env with micromamba from conda-forge
Installed tensorflow==1.15.5 (CPU TF1) with numpy 1.18.5, scipy, pandas, scikit-learn (not 'sklearn'), protobuf 3.20.3; skipped mpi4py
Created path.conf from path.conf.template with data_dir_local_cifar10 pointing at downloaded cifar-10-batches-bin
learners/uniform_quantization_tf/utils.py: fall back from tensorflow.contrib.lite to tensorflow.lite (TF>=1.14)
nets/*_run.py: delete absl.logging's --log_dir flag before redefining to avoid DuplicateFlagError
datasets/cifar10_dataset.py: module-level tf.constant mean/std replaced by numpy arrays (cross-graph error in TF 1.15)
No nvidia-smi on CPU; get_idle_gpus.py failure is ignored and env.sh sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''
